`sample-文档.pdf` is an original, one-page PDF fixture containing a red rectangle
on white. Its non-ASCII filename exercises document opening on Windows. It has
no fonts or external resources and is provided under kitpdf's MIT license.

`preview-pages.pdf` is an original two-page PDF with colored rectangles and
Helvetica labels. `preview-pages.epub` is an original two-chapter EPUB with
short headings and paragraphs. Both are provided under kitpdf's MIT license
and exercise real page rendering, default fonts, page boundaries, and the
embedded preview command protocol without external resources.
